newsitem.title: USA: Transitional to enter talks with Vencor.
newsitem.headline: Transitional to enter talks with Vencor.

text.p: Transitional Hospitals Corp said Friday it would begin merger talks with Vencor Inc -- shortly after Transitional signed a similar agreement with another company.
Transitional, a health care services provider, said its board of directors had authorized management to begin talks with Vencor regarding its offer to buy the company for $639 million or $16 a share.

The company has already signed a cash merger agreement with privately-held Select Medical Corp for $14.55 a share, but it said "its agreement with Select Medical ...(gave it) the right to enter into discussions with unsolicited bidders".
It said its deal with Select would remain in place.
Transitional's stock closed at 15-1/2 on the Nasdaq Stock Market on Thursday.

When Vencor announced its offer to buy Transitional on May 7, it said it was going to file a lawsuit to invalidate the $19.4 million fee that Transitional would have to pay if it were to renege on its deal with Select.
Select Medical officials declined to comment.
